Patients served 201,490 Patient services 1,705,936 Total market value $271.5M Featured publication Read the 2025 Impact Report ↗ Our journey From a flicker of light to a brighter way forward. 2001 A dental home begins A two-chair dental trailer opened with 55 volunteers. The first patient was a Vietnam veteran experiencing homelessness. Today Care across a lifetime Two state-of-the-art dental centers and the Tooth Bus now provide care from young childhood through senior adulthood. Next More than a smile Brighter Way continues expanding access through collaborative, entrepreneurial partnerships that strengthen the whole community. “Transforming More Than Smiles” is a pathway out of poverty, strengthened by collaborative community efforts. The Edmund H. Portnoy memorial dedication Photo: Dana Gibbons In Memoriam A lasting legacy Edmund H. Portnoy, PhD Long-time Board Member · Honorary Founder of The Brighter Way Endowment With gratitude, Brighter Way remembers Ed as a joyous, kind-hearted champion of human services philanthropy. His compassion, service, and belief in brighter possibilities continue through the people and mission he helped strengthen. A legacy of service The Brighter Way Endowment carries Ed's everlasting spirit forward by helping sustain transformational oral healthcare for future generations. Arizona taxpayers can make a voluntary cash donation to a Qualifying Charitable Organization and may receive a dollar-for-dollar, nonrefundable state income tax credit—up to the annual limit and available tax liability. Brighter Way is a registered QCO QCO 20880 2026 individual maximum $506 Single, head of household, or married filing separately 2026 joint maximum $1,009 Married filing jointly Verify current limits with the Arizona Department of Revenue ↗ 2026 credit estimator See the potential impact of your gift. Individual Up to $506 Married filing jointly Up to $1,009 Donation amount $506 $0 $506 $100 $250 Maximum Potential 2026 Arizona tax credit $506 Your gift goes directly to Brighter Way; the credit may reduce your Arizona income tax liability by the same amount, subject to eligibility and limits. Donate $506 ↗ 1 Make a cash gift Donate to Brighter Way Institute and use QCO code 20880. 2 Keep your receipt Save the donation acknowledgement with your tax records. 3 File Arizona Form 321 Claim the QCO credit with your Arizona individual income tax return. 4 Confirm with an adviser Eligibility and benefit depend on your tax liability and circumstances. This estimator is educational and is not tax advice. Arizona QCO credits are nonrefundable and cannot exceed available tax liability. Consult a qualified tax professional and the Arizona Department of Revenue. Make a brighter way possible Your gift restores health, dignity, and possibility. A stronger community. Brighter Way has a transformational mission to provide comprehensive oral healthcare for vulnerable adults, children, veterans, those experiencing homelessness, and individuals with special needs. Meet our board ↓ View reports & financials 25 Years of a brighter way Transforming more than smiles. An Arizona nonprofit approaching its 25th Anniversary Milestone, Brighter Way is building a healthy community through an entrepreneurial and collaborative model that provides outstanding oral healthcare to underserved individuals from young children to senior adults. Dental centers 2 Mobile access Tooth Bus Arizona QCO 20880 Our collaborative model Oral health opens a pathway out of poverty. “Transforming More Than Smiles” is a pathway out of poverty strengthened by collaborative community efforts. We provide services through two unique dental centers and provide remote access through Tooth Bus — a partnership with UnitedHealthcare. Board Member Read biography → Emelie Gonzales Board Member Read biography → Jean Kalbacher Board Member Read biography → Rob Laizure, Sr. Board Member Read biography → Corrie Worth Board Member Read biography → Board biography Charlie Clark , D.M.D. Board Chair Pediatric Dentist, Pediatric Dental Specialists Dr. Clark joined the Brighter Way Board in 2016. He has also served in board leadership positions for several local Arizona community nonprofits, with a passion for improving access to and delivery of oral health services for those in need. In 2015, Dr. Clark was recognized by the American Dental Association with the Golden Apple Award for New Dentist Leadership. He received his certificate in Pediatric Dentistry from the Children’s Hospital of Wisconsin and completed his dental education at the Arizona School of Dentistry & Oral Health. He continues his private practice as a Pediatric Dental Specialist in the East Valley. The people behind the mission Leadership Team 01 Kris Volcheck, DDS, MBA Founding CEO / President 02 Dustin M.
